proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12803.3 gives Pali/Prakrit cha, Hindi cha, Punjabi che and Nepali cha under *kṣaṭ/*kṣvaṭ. This selects the affricate branch, distinct from the ṣ- and ṣv- branches. Comparative check: jaun chai “six” (f_i3anqwruuoiqa). The exact survey spelling and phonetic marks remain untouched. Stress, vowel articulation, release marks and source palatal/sibilant notation were reviewed as local details; the full form and sense support the same family. The link does not settle uncertain transfer within Indo-Aryan.
